1.e4 a6 2.d4 b5 3.Nf3 Bb7.strategy: Develops with pressure on the undefended e4 pawn. Nc3 is not available as a defence because of ...b4, so White has to find another way to hold e4, while Black gains play along the long diagonal and on the queenside.

1.e4 a6 2.d4 b5 3.Nf3 Bb7 4.Bd3.strategy: The main line: it defends e4 with a developing move, unlike Nbd2, which would block the c1-bishop. The bishop also looks at b5, guarded by the a6 pawn, and keeps White's broad centre intact while Black has to undermine it from a distance.
